newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close higher, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close higher, seen rising.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Tuesday's new accounts day on blue-chip buying by long-term investors, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index closed 3.41 points, or 0.25 percent, higher at 1,358.99 amid 146 losers and 91 gainers in a turnover of 27 million shares.
The index moved both ways but resisted a sharp fall, dealer Majid Chapra said. The market remained steady most of the day and closed slightly higher.
"Stability in the prices of top market capitalisation stocks kept the market on the upside," another dealer said.
Some blue chips posted fresh gains and investment stocks made marginal gains, but the market lacked enthusiasm associated with a bull run, dealer Ali Raza said.
Engro Chemical rose 3.00 rupees to 138, Fauji Fertiliser 0.85 to 64.60, Shell Pakistan 0.50 to 127, HUBCO 0.10 to 30.75, PTCL 0.05 to 33.70 and FFC Jordan 0.10 to 12.20.
